scope: Only Academy Compose lifecycle; source volumes preserved
persistence_method: All11 Academy tables plus6 persistent identity/configuration tables: sorted COPY SHA256 and row counts identical before/after. Session/lock tables excluded from lifecycle equality; full backups verified separately.

health_latency_ms.scope: Serial local unauthenticated health via nginx; not authenticated workload, concurrency, throughput or capacity benchmark

timing_boundary: Readiness waits exclude Docker Compose command duration; total stop/start/restart wall time not measured.

authenticated_courses_latency_ms.scope: Sequential GET /api/courses as real synthetic learner-a after PKCE login; tokens memory-only; includes authorization and DB read, excludes login time; not concurrent throughput or learning outcomes.
